sahneler.metin: During a concert, fire swept through a Rhode Island nightclub.
In minutes, one hundred people were killed.
The band's pyrotechnics sprayed sparks toward the walls.
The walls were covered in soundproofing foam.
That foam caught fire almost instantly.
The crowd rushed for the front door and was trapped.
Many existing nightclubs were then required to install sprinklers.

aciklama:
Station nightclub was engulfed by fire during a concert. The cause: flexible polyurethane foam used as soundproofing burning extremely fast.
